title: BoardGameGeek Bestsellers (Fallback to Plays)
content:
1. **Flip 7**
*21 months on the list*
Score the cards in front of you, or take another card, risking everything you hold?
![Flip 7](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-12/toplist/bgg_d2042f63.jpg)

*8 months on the list*
Pit a cast of crazy characters against each other in a madcap race to the finish.
![Magical Athlete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-12/toplist/bgg_4bacbb86.png)

3. **Harmonies**
*29 months on the list*
Create your own landscape and habitats to welcome animals.
![Harmonies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-12/toplist/bgg_d16f27c2.jpg)

4. **Ark Nova**
*57 months on the list*
Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects.
![Ark Nova](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-10-12/toplist/bgg_91da5acd.jpg)

5. **Castle Combo**
*24 months on the list*

*93 months on the list*
